_que_es: Géneros y eventos (hud-icons, hoja D). Primero la base: node tools/render3d/icons.cjs render pets moon fire dice treadmill pickaxe fishing magnet heart --out <carpeta>; después python tools/iconsheet.py compose <los 9 png en orden> --out base.png y python tools/imagegen.py generate skills/_shared/iconos/recetas/hud-d-generos.json --ref base.png.

ia.prompt: Keep the same 9 objects, in this order: 1) pink pet paw print with four toe pads, 2) pale yellow crescent moon with small gray night clouds, 3) chunky orange flame with a yellow inner flame, 4) white rounded dice showing black pips and one red pip on top, 5) small treadmill with a blue belt, gray base and red console, 6) pickaxe with a silver head and a brown wooden handle, 7) cute orange cartoon fish with a big eye, 8) red horseshoe magnet with silver tips, 9) glossy pink-red heart.
